entries.claim: There is no free nationwide owner-name property search; ownership lives across ~3,100 counties under 48+ recording statutes, so 'widest net' means maximizing independent discovery channels and pivots and taking the union.
source_refs: PLAN.md §1 'The reality this plan is built around'
entries.notes: Foundational premise of the whole design. Authoritative within PLAN.md (already-completed research).

entries.claim: Property under ownership-or-control surfaces through 9 independent discovery channels (assessor owner-name, recorder grantor-grantee index, mailing-address pivot, entity graph, lien/judgment+UCC, bankruptcy A/B+SOFA, court records, people-search, concealment piercing); each catches what a direct owner-name assessor search misses.
entries.notes: Channel completeness strategy. Recorder grantor-grantee index flagged highest-yield free channel.

entries.claim: Owner-search capability by jurisdiction drives routing: true statewide owner search = MD/MA/MT; owner-friendly county-by-county = FL/TX/AZ/NV; name-blocked (use recorder index) = CA (Gov. Code §7928.205), Cook County IL, NJ (Daniel's Law); everywhere else county-by-county.
entries.notes: Portal availability is volatile (T2/empirical); routing matrix maintained in a reference file. Statute citations are T1-grade where cited.

entries.claim: The recorder grantor-grantee name index is the highest-yield free channel and the workaround for name-blocked states; it catches LLC/trust transfers, roll lag, and name-suppressed owners.
entries.notes: Core discovery channel; design centers v1 on this plus channels 1,3,4.

entries.claim: The mailing-address pivot (ArcGIS REST MAIL_ADDR LIKE, bulk-roll group-by, FL statewide cadastral layer) surfaces portfolios held under many entity names but billed to one back office.
entries.notes: ArcGIS REST is a free queryable interface to many county/state parcel layers; FL exposes a statewide cadastral layer.

entries.claim: The entity graph expands from a seed (person -> officer/agent -> entities -> sibling entities & people -> parcels) using SoS + OpenCorporates; nodes = {name, person, entity, address, agent, phone, email, parcel, loan, lien, deed, court-case, UCC} and edges = 'shares attribute X'.
entries.notes: The graph engine is the spine: it rediscovers its own worklist. SoS registries + OpenCorporates are free.

entries.claim: Every edge stores temporal + provenance fields {source, source_url, confidence, date_first_seen, date_last_verified, effective_date, expiration_date, raw_evidence} because ownership is time-variant and an edge needs an 'as of'.
entries.notes: Hard schema requirement; grounds the provenance NFR and auditability.

entries.claim: Edge strength order (strongest->noisiest): shared officer/member > shared mailing/principal address > shared phone > shared email/domain > shared filing batch/organizer > shared registered agent (only if non-commercial); inverse-frequency weighting separates signal from noise.
entries.notes: A value shared by 2 nodes is strong; shared by thousands is noise. Non-commercial agent on a few entities is a strong control link (inverse signal kept).

entries.claim: The hub-guard (registered-agent stop-list hub_agents.txt + dynamic hub detection at a frequency threshold, default 25 + bounded hops, default 2 degrees + inverse-frequency weighting + log-every-prune) prevents combinatorial blow-up while keeping coverage honest; CMRA/virtual-office/UPS-Store addresses flagged.
entries.notes: Threshold 25 and hop 2 are defaults (Assumption/tunable per D7/D8). Logging every prune is mandatory for honest coverage.

entries.claim: Swarm agents must be isolated/blind to each other; two agents independently landing on the same parcel is genuine corroboration, which makes 'Verified = 2+ independent isolated agents' meaningful rather than circular.
entries.notes: Adapted from acos-swarm-research. Isolation matters for correctness, not just speed.

entries.claim: The between-rounds synthesizer cross-references findings -> confidence, PRESERVES conflicts as manual-review flags (never silently harmonizes), hub-prunes + enforces the hop limit before seeding the next round, and emits newly discovered seeds; the loop stops when a round yields no new high-confidence nodes.
entries.notes: The control point a generic swarm lacks; holds the hub stop-list + hop counter. Conflict preservation is a hard rule.

entries.claim: Stage-1 identity resolution runs before entity discovery: expand aliases, maiden/Jr-Sr/middle-name variants, prior addresses, spouse/relatives/associates via free people-search (ThatsThem/TruePeopleSearch/FastPeopleSearch) as LEADS ONLY (corroborate against a primary record before scoring); require >=2 anchors for common names.
entries.notes: People-search is leads-only; DOB/age used only as a disambiguation anchor subject to the compliance gate.

entries.claim: Concealed holdings are pierced via recorded instruments: land trusts (Collateral Assignment of Beneficial Interest + personal guaranty + IL 765 ILCS 405 public-disclosure register; FL 689.071 more opaque), nominees/series LLCs (mortgage/deed-of-trust signatories + guaranty + UCC debtor name + tax-bill mailing triangulation), trusts (search person as trustee + trust name), contract-for-deed/life estate/TIC (read the vesting clause). DBA/assumed-name filings work for us.
entries.notes: Channel 9. Phased to v2 for depth; flagged in v1. Statute citations (765 ILCS 405, FL 689.071) are T1-grade.

entries.claim: FinCEN BOI is NOT usable (non-public; the March 2025 interim final rule exempted virtually all US domestic entities so the data often does not exist); paid APIs / data brokers (ATTOM, CoreLogic, BatchData, RealEstateAPI, Middesk, TLO/IDI) are excluded by the free-only constraint.
entries.notes: Hard exclusions. BOI flag-only; free-sources-only is a locked constraint.

entries.claim: The merged scoring rubric assigns concrete points (+40 owner-of-record exact, +25 tax-mailing match, +25 manager/member/officer, +20 shared phone/email, +10 spouse/associate, +10 per independent corroborating channel capped +20; -40 registered-agent-only, -30 common-name-only, -20 hub/virtual-office mailing, -10 inactive/dissolved, -10 conflicting owner names; cap <=40 if the only link runs through a hub) and confidence tiers >=75 high / 50-74 candidate / <50 weak (tunable).
entries.notes: Points and 75/50 cutoffs are tunable defaults (Assumption per D6). Drives score.py determinism + review flags.

entries.claim: The manual-review flag taxonomy (common name, registered-agent-only match, inactive/dissolved entity, recently transferred, mailing addr law-firm/virtual-office/CMRA, trust ownership, no mortgage data found, conflicting owner names, data > 90 days) preserves uncertainty for human review.
entries.notes: Flags surface in the report; never silently resolved.

entries.claim: Per confirmed parcel, an estimated equity picture is computed from FREE data: assessed value (flag 'assessed, not market'), last sale price+date, original recorded mortgage/deed-of-trust amount+date with a stated amortization assumption for remaining balance, estimated equity = value - estimated encumbrances; 'no mortgage data found' flagged; true AVM/current payoff need paid sources and are stated as a limitation, never fabricated.
entries.notes: Every figure labeled 'estimated'; fabricating AVM/payoff is an explicit anti-pattern.

entries.claim: A BLOCKING compliance gate runs first every time: permissible purpose mapped to statute (DPPA 2721(b)(3) debt recovery / (b)(4) judgment enforcement; FCRA 1681b(a)(3)(A) for any credit pull; dossier flagged 'asset location / debt recovery - NOT for eligibility'); debt classification consumer vs. commercial (FDCPA applies to consumer only); GLBA anti-pretexting HARD BLOCK; scraping posture (official feeds/record APIs, public no-login pages, respect robots/rate limits, per-datum provenance).
entries.notes: Blocking, non-bypassable. GLBA hard block has no general debt-collection exception. Statutes are T1; counsel sign-off out of scope (not legal advice).

entries.claim: A JSON cache wraps every external lookup keyed by person/entity/address/parcel/query with freshness TTLs (corporate ~30 d, property ~30-60 d, deed/transfer more often), handling rate limits + 403 blocks and making re-runs cheap and auditable; per-record freshness stamps surface in the report.
entries.notes: TTL numbers are PLAN.md suggestions (Assumption/tunable per matter).

entries.claim: Output must use mandated hedged language ('likely controlled by', 'possible ownership connection via mailing address'); reserve 'owns' only where a title record directly supports it; never 'definitely owns' otherwise - for accuracy and legal control.
entries.notes: Hard output rule; legal + accuracy control.

entries.claim: The skill is a project skill (disable-model-invocation: true, user-invocable: true) = methodology SKILL.md + small stdlib-only Python helpers + reference files, with no external infrastructure (no Neo4j/Elasticsearch/Postgres/billing); a full audit trail is written under workspace/<session-id>/round-NN/agent-NN/findings.md + synthesis/.
entries.notes: Form-factor + no-infra are locked constraints; explicit-invocation chosen because skip tracing carries compliance weight.

entries.claim: The skill composes existing skills: embedded adapted swarm (pattern from acos-swarm-research, v1), acos-loan-doc-generator-with-visual-verification (institutional render, v2), schedule (recurring monitoring/alerts, v2), testing (unit tests for helpers, v1), acos-decide (ADR for D1-D8, build time), fewer-permission-prompts/update-config (allowlist + swarm-isolation hook, build time), deep-research (optional depth).
entries.notes: Skill-of-skills delegation. v1 embeds the swarm (Decision D1 default).

entries.claim: Honest limitations stated in the skill: no free national owner search; ~3 statewide systems + a few friendly states else county-by-county; CA/NJ/Cook suppress owner names; big counties (LA/SF/King/Maricopa) gate the richest owner+mailing data behind purchase; document images often cost; many portals 403-block bots; FinCEN BOI unusable; people-search = leads only; equity figures are estimates not AVMs; not legal advice; nationwide 50-state PI/collector/data-broker licensing analysis out of scope.
entries.notes: Stated limitations are a first-class output requirement (coverage & limits footer).

entries.claim: PLAN.md records eight default decisions (D1 embed swarm; D2 Markdown v1 then doc-skill render v2; D3 hard blocking compliance gate; D4 channels 1-4 + recorder full, 5-9 phased; D5 v1 script set; D6 75/50 tiers; D7 hub threshold 25; D8 hop limit 2) that should be captured in an acos-decide ADR at build time.
entries.notes: Authoritative decision defaults; the diagnostic slice locks these via an ADR.
